value.rationale: Exact random section diameter laws are natural benchmarks for convex geometry and randomized information recovery. The finite-cylinder product has a positive maximum-diameter atom, unlike smooth one-spike ellipsoids; its exact Gaussian cap-contact threshold and separate fixed-codimension chi-square limit reveal structural behavior not a trivial constant substitution. The result covers all cylinder heights and dimensions m>=2 rather than an arbitrary isolated parameter.
